program.reference:
n, m = input().split()
n, m = int(n), int(m)
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
b = list(map(int, input().split()))
max_b = max(a)
f = [b[0]]
ans = - 10 ** 18
for i in range(1, n):
    f.append(None)
    for step in a:
        if i - step >= 0 and f[i - step] is not None:
            f[i] = max(f[i], f[i - step]) if f[i] is not None else f[i - step]
    if f[i] is not None:
        f[i] += b[i]
    if f[i] is not None and i + max_b >= n:
        ans = max(ans, f[i])
print(ans)
